newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honda shares up, aided by demand for blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Honda shares up, aided by demand for blue chips.

text.p: Shares in Honda Motor Co Ltd firmed in Tokyo morning trade on Tuesday, supported by widespread demand for blue-chip shares despite the sustained plunge in the overall stock market, traders said.
As of 0101 GMT, the shares were up 50 yen at 3,130 yen, on turnover of 2.34 million, making the issue the fourth most heavily traded share on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
Other blue chips, such as Sony Corp, were also bought despite the overall gloom pervading the markets. The Sony shares were up 10 yen at 7,370 yen as of 0124 GMT.
But not all blue chip shares were able to avoid becoming a selling target for investors. Shares in such companies as Canon Inc, Hitachi Ltd and NEC Corp were dropping on profit-taking, traders said.
As of 0130 GMT, Canon shares had dropped by 10 yen to 2,320, while Hitachi dipped 20 yen to 1,040 and NEC fell 40 yen to 1,360 in heavy Tokyo morning trading.
